review.assessment: The diff inserts a scale-factor correction into `summarise(readings)` before the alert threshold check. When more than `MAX_ALERTS` readings are out of range, it reassigns `readings` with each value divided by 10, then immediately recalculates `below` and `above` against the corrected data. This prevents a spurious `AlertStorm` exception for an entire batch that shares a common sensor scaling error, while preserving report line shapes and adhering to the task constraints. Acceptance tests confirm the logic runs cleanly and produces expected outputs.
